teachers.teacherBio: Co-founder of Rising tide Dance academy. Devon brings a unique blend of innate artistic intuition, rigorous technical training, and multi-genre versatility to the studio. Starting their journey as a self-taught dancer in hip-hop and ballet, Devon’s passion and dedication quickly led them to Colorado State University, where they earned a Bachelor of Arts in Dance alongside a Bachelor of Science in Computer Science. During their time at CSU, Devon trained across all foundational styles with a specialized focus on choreography and movement composition. This dual background in artistry and analytical problem-solving informs their structured, intentional approach to teaching. Today, Devon teaches Ballet, Hip-Hop, Jazz, Contemporary, and Lyrical, aiming to foster technical growth, musicality, and creative expression in dancers of all levels.
CO-Founder of Rising Tide Dance Academy. Grew up competing at Millers Dance academy in Colorado.
